obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.

Logging capabilities of high-risk AI systems must enable recording of events relevant for identifying risks or substantial modifications, facilitating post-market monitoring, and monitoring system operation.

For high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III point 1(a), logging capabilities must at minimum record the period of each use, the reference database used, input data that led to a match, and the identification of persons involved in verifying results.
exceptions: Applies specifically and only to high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III, point 1(a)
